label: Beurre noir
note: Black butter: a similar sauce cooked longer

about.text: Black butter: a sauce like brown butter, but cooked longer.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

picture.author: Les Hotels Paris Rive Gauche - AlainB

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Made like brown butter, only cooked darker, then stopped with an acid. No temperature or time is given in the source; the colour is the guide.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Melted over low heat until the water has evaporated and the butter colours, cooked past the hazelnut stage of brown butter.
Vinegar, lemon juice or white wine (capers also) is stirred in after the cooking, and parsley at the end.
